# Archive

Superseded material, kept for the record. Nothing here describes the current model.

* `old_paper/`: an early paper draft (`main.tex`, `overleaf_paper.zip`). Its accuracy numbers
  (for example IoU 74.6%, APLS 76.8%) and its ablation table were never measured. Do not cite them.
  The current paper is `docs/paper/main.tex`.
* `early_reports/`: progress reports written before the evaluation was run.
* `backend_outputs/`: generated files from that period; `ablation_results.*` only contain
  placeholders because the ablation was never run.
